One of Dolly Parton's most heartfelt legacies is the Imagination Library, sparking a love of reading in children across the globe. Now, actress and author Danica McKellar and designer Julie Couch give the headquarters a heartwarming makeover.

title: Hometown Heroes
description:
S01 E04 — A Tribute to The Brett Boyer Foundation
In Franklin, Tennessee, family is at the heart of everything-and it's also at the core of The Brett Boyer Foundation's mission. Nashville designer Julie Couch transforms their headquarters to radiate the same joy and hope they bring to so many.

title: The Yacht Life
description:
S01 E02 — The Paglia's \"Executive Decision\"
The Paglias are avid anglers with interests that include cooking and photography; Captain Boomies joins them aboard their yacht Executive Decision for a deep-sea adventure packed with fishing tips, cigars, and a lot of fun.

title: The Yacht Life
description:
S01 E04 — Captain Gill's \"Wharf Rat\"
Captain Boomies discovers the Bahamian-blue Wharf Rat, a yacht decked out with Italian countertops, a custom tequila dispenser, and a killer sound system—all designed to turn every day on the water into a party.

title: The Yacht Life
description:
S01 E06 — The Arnold's \"A-Sea\"
In Knoxville, Tennessee, Captain Boomies joins the Arnold family for a very special maiden voyage; laying eyes on their yacht for the first time-custom-built to match their private jet, it's a big moment.

title: Alt Home
description:
S01 E05 — From Cats to Co-Living: A Place for Everyone
Jillian dives into the heart of community living, exploring how we create spaces that bring us-and even our pets-closer together; first, Jillian meets Alan, famously known as "The Catio Guy" and then heads to Cohaus, a vibrant co-living community.

title: Alt Home
description:
S01 E06 — Innovation, Design and Style: Modern Marvels
Jillian tours three boundary-pushing homes with a modern twist: the iconic Garduno Heiser treehouse, Los Angeles' first 3D-printed, low-carbon micro-living home and a vibrant modern masterpiece that redefines what it means to live artfully.

title: Fame to Table
description:

Matthew meets two culinary trailblazers; first, he visits Matthew McIvor, the genius behind Proudly Serving's legendary smashburger and then dives into the art of babka with the one and only King of Babka himself, Chef Shimi Aaron.

title: Fame to Table
description:
